title: Social Saver
description:
Social Saver is the ultimate tool designed for users who want to save and organize their favorite social media statuses effortlessly. Developed by Vasu Thakor, this application provides a seamless experience for downloading photo and video statuses directly to your device.

Key Features:
• Instant Status Saver: Save photo and video statuses with just one tap.
• Secret History (Auto-Save): The standout feature! It automatically captures and stores viewed statuses for up to 30 days, ensuring you never miss a fleeting moment.
• Built-in Media Player: View saved photos and play videos directly within the app without needing external players.
• Smart Organization: Your media is categorized and sorted by date, making it easy to find what you're looking for.
• High-Quality UI: Enjoy a branded, smooth interface with premium animations for a superior user experience.
• Privacy First: All downloads and "Secret History" data are stored locally on your device. We do not upload your personal media to any servers..
